tools.name: purge_deactivated_account
tools.description: Permanently deletes a deactivated user account along with its sessions and saved preferences, then runs the data cleanup script for that user's stored files. Refuses to act on accounts that are still active.

params.name: user_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the deactivated account to delete

params.name: confirm_email
params.description: Email address on the account, which must match to confirm deletion

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "/var/app/data/users.db"
CLEANUP_SCRIPT = "/opt/app/scripts/cleanup_user_files.sh"


@tool
def purge_deactivated_account(user_id: int, confirm_email: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(user_id, int) or user_id <= 0:
        return "Error: user_id must be a positive integer."
    if not confirm_email or "@" not in confirm_email:
        return "Error: confirm_email must be a valid email address."

    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("SELECT email, status FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,))
        row = cur.fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return f"Error: no user found with id {user_id}."
        email, status = row
        if email.lower() != confirm_email.strip().lower():
            return "Error: confirm_email does not match the account email."
        if status != "deactivated":
            return f"Error: account status is '{status}', only deactivated accounts can be purged."

        cur.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,))
        cur.execute("DELETE FROM preferences WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,))
        cur.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,))
        conn.commit()
    except sqlite3.Error as exc:
        conn.rollback()
        return f"Error: database failure: {exc}"
    finally:
        conn.close()

    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [CLEANUP_SCRIPT, str(user_id)],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=120,
        )
    except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError) as exc:
        return f"Account {user_id} deleted, but file cleanup failed: {exc}"

    if proc.returncode != 0:
        return f"Account {user_id} deleted, but cleanup exited with {proc.returncode}: {proc.stderr.strip()}"
    return f"Account {user_id} deleted and files cleaned up."

tools.name: send_password_reset_email
tools.description: Looks up a user by email address and sends them a password reset link by email. Returns whether a message was sent.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of the user who needs a reset link

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage
from langchain_core.tools import tool


@tool
def send_password_reset_email(email: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect("/var/app/data/users.db")
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, name, reset_token FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email.lower(),)
    ).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    result = {"email": email, "sent": False}
    if row is None:
        result["reason"] = "user not found"
        return result
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = "no-reply@example.com"
    msg["To"] = email
    msg["Subject"] = "Reset your password"
    msg.set_content(f"Hi {row[1]},\nReset here: https://example.com/reset?token={row[2]}")
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.example.com", 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(msg)
    result["sent"] = True
    result["user_id"] = row[0]
    return result
